# Figma-to-Video Skill for Muse

Brings your Figma designs into a HyperFrames video composition: static assets (SVG/PNG rendered over REST and frozen locally with recorded provenance), brand tokens and styles, components rebuilt as editable HTML at exact Figma geometry with binding to your tokens, storyboard sections reconstructed as real element animations (storyboard frames are decoded as keyframes, never played as stills), plus connector-assisted motion and shader handling. The integration needs only a read-only Figma personal access token — it never writes to Figma; every import lands as a local frozen file so renders stay deterministic. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: you need a Figma account plus your own read-only token (minted at figma.com/settings); variable import is Enterprise-gated on Figma's side and gracefully falls back to published styles; motion and shader phases need a compatible Figma connector or a native export. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
